_comment: Copy next to your project (e.g. project/v1/srt/music.json) and pass with --config. background_music: none (default, no music) | auto (pick + trim from music-library/catalog.json) | manual (use manual.file; manual.start = seconds into the track, null = auto-trim). category: auto | tech | business | product | tutorial | general. Levels are dB relative to the voice.
